name: Unauthorized DHCP servers
content: 未经授权的 DHCP 服务器可能很容易被设置起来。
meaning: 未经授权的 DHCP 服务器可能很容易被设置起来。
evidence_quote: Such servers can then send false and potentially disruptive information to clients such as incorrect or duplicate IP addresses, incorrect routing information (including spoof routers, etc.), incorrect domain nameserver addresses (such as spoof nameservers), and so on.
